# gigahost_dns_zone (Data Source)

Looks up a single DNS zone by `id` or `name`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "gigahost_dns_zone" "example" {
  name = "example.no"
}

output "zone_id" {
  value = data.gigahost_dns_zone.example.id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `name` (String)

### Read-Only

- `active` (Boolean)
- `external_dns` (Boolean)
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `is_registered` (Boolean)
- `protected` (Boolean)
- `record_count` (Number)
- `registrar` (String)
- `type` (String)
- `updated_at` (Number)
